newsitem.title: ITALY: Costumed Mafia fugitive nabbed in carnival arrest.
newsitem.headline: Costumed Mafia fugitive nabbed in carnival arrest.

text.p: A fugitive Mafioso dressed as Hollywood heart throb Rudolf Valentino failed to fool police who arrested him on his way to a carnival party.
Santo Vitale, 30, was arrested in his car on Tuesday evening. He was driving to the party in Catania, eastern Sicily, with his wife and some friends.
Vitale was dressed as Valentino, the late Italian-born actor who was a leading cinema idol of the 1920s and a symbol of the Latin lover.
Vitale was wanted in connection with a series of robberies in the Florence area and was also the focus of investigations into his suspected links to the Sicilian Mafia.
